workflow: A caller supplies a floating-point value for conversion into a narrower numeric representation.
Rounding, scaling, or splitting produces an integral result outside the destination type’s representable range.
The implementation converts that out-of-range result before checking whether it fits.
The conversion invokes undefined behavior, so later validation cannot reliably report a range error and execution may produce diagnostics or platform-dependent behavior.
decision_reason: The failure workflow is materially identical: an out-of-range floating-point result is converted to an integer before range validation, making the conversion undefined and invalidating subsequent checks.
